title: Tianwen-4 · Uranus flyby branch
note: Reconstructed mission concept, not an official Tianwen-4 trajectory. Forward n-body flight with ideal targeting corrections, prescribed JPL ephemerides and heliocentric indirect terms. This file follows the Uranus flyby branch after Jupiter; it does not include the Jovian orbiter. Navigation uncertainty is not modeled. The curve continues to April 2045 after the March Uranus flyby.

provenance.planet_arcs: One-day JPL baseline, for visual context

integration_validation.method: Continuous Hermite reconstruction of the existing XYZV, with local closest-approach refinement against cached JPL planet-center ephemerides
integration_validation.scope: Solar and eight-planet surface clearance; moon encounters and navigation uncertainty are not part of this interplanetary audit

trajectory_files.note: Original integrated concept. See Model & data for its force model, targeting burns and limitations. CSV preserves every numeric XYZV row, including any repeated impulse epochs.
